capabilities: Generate Markdown index files for Canvas, PDF, and image attachments
Extract text content from PDFs and images using the Google Gemini API
Synchronize index files automatically when attachments change or are deleted
Make attachment links visible in graph, backlinks, and outgoing links panels
Expose attachment content to Markdown-only plugins and AI chat plugins
disambiguation: Not an attachment organizer or converter; it only generates synchronized Markdown index copies next to the original files.
extras: Initial indexing of large vaults can take days and may restart Obsidian when processing big files; mobile auto-indexing should be enabled only after desktop indexing completes; a Google API key is required for PDF and image text extraction, while Canvas files work without it.
intentEvidence: This plugin enhances Obsidian's ability to manage various attachment types
problem: Obsidian attachments like Canvas files, PDFs, and images are invisible in the graph view, unsearchable by content, and inaccessible to plugins that only work with Markdown files.

relations.evidence: Works particularly well with plugins like Smart Connections and Copilot
Works particularly well with plugins like Smart Connections and Copilot

summary: Attachment indexer that creates searchable Markdown index files for Canvas, PDF, and image files so they surface in search, graph, and backlinks.
